name: site_id
description: Primary key. A prospective location only: no site_id ever appears in stores, sales or inventory.

name: zip_code
description: ZIP the property sits in. The only join path to demand, demographics and feedback, since a candidate has no trading history.

name: street_address
description: Illustrative street block for a fictional opportunity; not an actual available property or exact building address.

name: latitude
description: Approximate retail-corridor latitude, WGS84; not a surveyed property point.

name: available_sqft
description: Leasable floor area. Compare against stores.square_feet, which is the same measure for a trading store.

name: monthly_rent
description: Synthetic asking rent per month in USD, excluding fit-out and operating costs; not a market quote.

name: listed_date
description: Date the property came to market. The site lifecycle analogue of stores.opened_date.
